claims.claim: Spoken / sighted in lat. 48 51, long. 33 12 (17th inst.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Louisiana (Br.), Thompson, Liverpool July 11, and
Queenstown the 12th, with mdse. and 517 pass. to the National Steam
Navigation Co. The L. experienced light westerly breezes during
greater part of the voyage. July 11, off the Skerries, passed steamship
Kangaroo, bound in; 12th inst., off Tuskar, passed steamship Queen,
bound E; 17th inst., in lat. 48 51, long. 33 12, passed a steamship, sup-
posed to be the Pennsylvania, bound E; 18th inst., in lat. 47 41, long.
38 19, exchanged signals with Norwegian ship Roska[?], bound E; 21st
inst., passed a French bark, at anchor, on the banks of New-Found-
land; 22d inst., in lat. 43, long. 56, exchanged signals with the ship
Adventure, bound W.
